text: Dr. Edward Pretorius builds [the Resonator, a machine that lets its users see beyond reality|threat|science playing god], and his assistant Crawford Tillinghast glimpses creatures drifting in the air before Pretorius is found decapitated. Psychiatrist Katherine McMichaels frees Crawford and returns with him and Detective Bubba Brownlee to the house, where [Pretorius comes back from the world beyond|images|monsters and hybrid creatures] with slime-covered arms and [a hunger for its pleasures|wants|lust and indulgence]. Meanwhile Crawford's [pineal gland swells until it pushes from his forehead|rules|the body changes].
